replacements.label: Overview description
replacements.find: The program is designed for churches, fellowships, campus ministries, leadership teams, and small groups that want a clear Scripture-centered framework for spiritual growth.
replacements.value: The program is designed for churches, fellowships, campus ministries, leadership teams, and small groups that want a clear Scripture-centered framework for spiritual growth.

replacements.label: Benefit 1 text
replacements.find: Guide participants through the book’s nine progressive chapters—from identity and formation to maturity, fellowship, service, and manifestation.
replacements.value: Guide participants through the book’s nine progressive chapters—from identity and formation to maturity, fellowship, service, and manifestation.

replacements.label: Benefit 2 text
replacements.find: Adapt the journey for a church-wide reading campaign, discipleship class, small-group series, leadership cohort, or ministry training experience.
replacements.value: Adapt the journey for a church-wide reading campaign, discipleship class, small-group series, leadership cohort, or ministry training experience.

replacements.label: Benefit 3 text
replacements.find: Every copy of the book includes access to the digital Companion Journal. Chapter studies, reflection prompts, teachings, and related resources help participants go deeper.
replacements.value: Every copy of the book includes access to the digital Companion Journal. Chapter studies, reflection prompts, teachings, and related resources help participants go deeper.

replacements.label: Benefit 4 text
replacements.find: Receive help planning the format, timeline, book quantity, delivery needs, and the most suitable support options for your church or ministry group.
replacements.value: Receive help planning the format, timeline, book quantity, delivery needs, and the most suitable support options for your church or ministry group.

replacements.label: Pathway — Congregational text
replacements.find: Invite the wider church to read together while sermons, classes, or group conversations reinforce each stage of formation.
replacements.value: Invite the wider church to read together while sermons, classes, or group conversations reinforce each stage of formation.

replacements.label: Pathway — Discipleship text
replacements.find: Use the chapter sequence, study questions, and journal reflections for structured weekly discussion and application.
replacements.value: Use the chapter sequence, study questions, and journal reflections for structured weekly discussion and application.

replacements.label: Pathway — Leadership text
replacements.find: Create space for ministry leaders and emerging leaders to examine character, responsibility, surrender, fellowship, and service.
replacements.value: Create space for ministry leaders and emerging leaders to examine character, responsibility, surrender, fellowship, and service.

replacements.label: Process 1 text
replacements.find: Share your ministry context, estimated number of participants, location, and the kind of journey you are considering.
replacements.value: Share your ministry context, estimated number of participants, location, and the kind of journey you are considering.

replacements.label: Process 2 text
replacements.find: We will help identify a practical pathway and discuss current book-order, delivery, resource, and support options.
replacements.value: We will help identify a practical pathway and discuss current book-order, delivery, resource, and support options.

replacements.label: Process 3 text
replacements.find: Set a schedule, identify facilitators, and decide how the book, digital journal, chapter studies, and teaching resources will work together.
replacements.value: Set a schedule, identify facilitators, and decide how the book, digital journal, chapter studies, and teaching resources will work together.

replacements.label: Process 4 text
replacements.find: Lead participants through a consistent rhythm of reading, reflection, prayer, discussion, practice, and spiritual growth.
replacements.value: Lead participants through a consistent rhythm of reading, reflection, prayer, discussion, practice, and spiritual growth.

replacements.label: FAQ — Who can become a partner?
FAQ answer — partner eligibility
replacements.find: Local churches, ministry fellowships, campus ministries, Christian leadership teams, discipleship groups, and other organized faith communities may express interest.
replacements.value: Local churches, ministry fellowships, campus ministries, Christian leadership teams, discipleship groups, and other organized faith communities may express interest.

replacements.label: FAQ — copies
replacements.find: Does every participant need a copy of the book?
replacements.value: Does every participant need a copy of the book?

replacements.label: FAQ answer — copies
replacements.find: Individual copies are recommended so each participant can read, mark key passages, and follow the journey personally. Every copy includes access to the digital Companion Journal.
replacements.value: Individual copies are recommended so each participant can read, mark key passages, and follow the journey personally. Every copy includes access to the digital Companion Journal.

replacements.label: FAQ — printed journal
replacements.find: Is a printed Companion Journal available?
replacements.value: Is a printed Companion Journal available?

replacements.label: FAQ answer — printed journal
replacements.find: No. The Companion Journal is currently provided digitally; a printed edition is not currently available.
replacements.value: No. The Companion Journal is currently provided digitally; a printed edition is not currently available.

replacements.label: FAQ — partner pricing
replacements.find: Are partner prices or discounts available?
replacements.value: Are partner prices or discounts available?

replacements.label: FAQ answer — partner pricing
replacements.find: Current options depend on quantity, destination, delivery, and the level of support requested. After receiving your interest form, we will discuss the most appropriate arrangement without locking your church into a commitment.
replacements.value: Current options depend on quantity, destination, delivery, and the level of support requested. After receiving your interest form, we will discuss the most appropriate arrangement without locking your church into a commitment.

replacements.label: FAQ — teaching session
replacements.find: Can we request a teaching session or author conversation?
replacements.value: Can we request a teaching session or author conversation?

replacements.label: FAQ answer — teaching session
replacements.find: You may include that request in the form. Speaking, virtual sessions, and leader conversations are considered according to timing, location, format, and availability.
replacements.value: You may include that request in the form. Speaking, virtual sessions, and leader conversations are considered according to timing, location, format, and availability.

replacements.find: The program is not simply about finishing a book. It is about helping believers cooperate with God’s process of formation.
replacements.value: The program is not simply about finishing a book. It is about helping believers cooperate with God’s process of formation.
